feeds.title: Patrycia Centeno Blog
feeds.description: Patrycia Centeno is a journalist, analyst, essayist, and advisor who is also a pioneer in the study of visual language as a tool for political and corporate communication. With insights honed from her experience in fashion journalism and political image consulting, she sheds light on the unspoken messages that influence how we perceive leaders and brands.
